name: freebsd-ncal-swprintf-byte-count
cve: FreeBSD r300005, Coverity CID 1007605/1007606 (no CVE assigned)
fixed_note: swprintf() and apparently wcsftime() want their output buffer size specified in terms of the number of wide characters and not sizeof(buffer): ncal passed sizeof(ws) and sizeof(buf) for wchar_t arrays (4 bytes per character), so a long month name or weekday could be written past the array.
args_note: built on Linux: D_MD_ORDER is a FreeBSD nl_langinfo item, __FBSDID a FreeBSD macro; term.h comes from ncurses (libncurses-dev)
